title: [BUG] Claude code crashing on load
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [x] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version: 0.2.76 (Claude Code)
- Operating System: MacOS 15.4.1
- Terminal:  Warp

## Bug Description
After auto updating to the latest version this morning, I started seeing the behavior in the attached screenshot.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/59d2ad0c-560f-4040-832f-0c3e9a2bf737)

## Steps to Reproduce
1. `cd` into desired directory
2. run `claude` in said directory
3. observe crash

## Expected Behavior
Claude should load and allow me to enter my prompt in the input box

## Actual Behavior
Claude crashes instead -- see above screenshot

## Additional Context
I'm using `bun` instead of `npm`
author: rhymiz
